verdict.rationale: The core interaction model is natural language: the user types a goal such as "Open Settings and go to Wi-Fi" and presses Start, and the agent carries it out across apps (for example, setting an alarm in Clock). Saved tasks can also be triggered from Siri and Shortcuts. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the commands work reliably, and evidence of conversational follow-up or mid-run refinement of commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Type a goal (for example "Open Settings and go to Wi-Fi") and press Start.
the agent leaves its own app, opens Clock, types the time into the wheel, ticks the days and saves.
Siri, Shortcuts, widgets and Control Center can run saved tasks.
